BrightID is a decentralized identity verification network. BrightID relies on a social connection graph to resist Sybil attacks. BrightID is open source.

Farcaster is a decentralized social network protocol. Farcaster ties user identities to on-chain registries on public blockchains. Farcaster stores social content off-chain across independent servers.

Secure Scuttlebutt is a peer-to-peer social network protocol. Secure Scuttlebutt stores each user's messages in append-only logs signed with that user's keys. Secure Scuttlebutt works offline-first and does not depend on a central server.

XMTP is an open messaging protocol for wallet-to-wallet communication. XMTP uses end-to-end encryption for messages. XMTP is open source.

Aragon is a framework for creating decentralized autonomous organizations on Ethereum. Aragon uses smart contracts to implement organizational governance. Aragon is open source.
